title: Major Updates on Binance Referral Pro: Earn Up to 50% Sustained Commission
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, We are excited to announce significant updates to the Binance Referral and Affiliate Program designed to help users maximize their commission earnings. All eligible users will soon enjoy commission rates of up to  50%  across both Spot and Futures trading with  no time limitation or commission cap .  Summary of Major Updates:  Performance-based commission structure provides opportunities to all eligible users.  Commission evaluations and rate adjustments will be fully automated for all eligible users by default; no application is required. Users who achieve  Tier 1   or above  in either Futures or Spot Evaluation will be upgraded to be an  Affiliate  under Binance Affiliate Program! Click  here  to learn more about Binance Affiliate Program and its benefits. Users who achieve a Futures commission rate of 30% or higher  through the evaluation  will have their  1-year Futures commission validity period waived .   The Binance Affiliates Futures Bonus will be discontinued and replaced by the upgraded benefits mentioned above. The bonus for  2025-07  will be the final distribution and will be paid out before  2025-08-15 . Referrals who open a Futures account will  no longer  receive the 10% rebate for the first month, regardless of whether the account was opened before or after this change. Similarly, inviters will no longer earn any part of the 10% rebate from their referrals, and this will reduce their maximum rebate accordingly. Please note that the 10% rebate will be gradually removed for all users from 2025-08-01 00:00 (UTC) onward. Starting from  2025-10-25 , all users can set the Futures rebate rate shared with invited friends to up to a  maximum of 20% . Once set, this rate  cannot be changed . The new Futures rate will apply to all current and new referrals, except those who already have a higher Futures rate, which will remain unchanged.  The Spot automated evaluation will be launched and conducted individually soon. Starting from  2025-11-25 ,  every new trader who registers and completes their first trade on Futures, Spot and/or Margin during the evaluation cycle will be subject to a mandatory risk assessment. If any risk is detected, the new trader will be marked as  "unqualified"  and they will be excluded from the total number of new traders counted towards the commission evaluation for that cycle. For example, if you invite three new traders and one of them is marked as  "unqualified" , only two will be counted toward your commission evaluation.  If you believe the evaluation result requires review, you may submit an  appeal  during the corresponding evaluation cycle. Starting from  2026-03-19 , all Futures trading volume generated by referrals of regular to VIP 2 will be calculated towards the Futures Evaluation performance. This is in accordance with the updated Futures VIP thresholds. Click  here  to view more. Effective  2026-06-12 , bStocks trading volume and new bStocks traders will be counted toward Spot Evaluation. Eligible users will also earn commissions from their referrals’ bStocks trading activity. 1. Futures Referral & Affiliate Program  Effective from  2025-08-01,  all eligible users are automatically evaluated over a 3-month period and can earn up to a  50% sustained Futures commission rate  based on the following new tier structure: Notes: * Futures Commission Time Limitation:  The period during which the  referral  generates Futures commission for their inviter after the referral opens a Futures account. ** Futures Trading Volume : Only trades that incur a trading fee will be included in the “Trading Volume” *** New Futures Traders : The number of users who register during the evaluation period and complete their first Futures trade within the same evaluation period. Affiliates who achieve a future commission rate of 30% or higher by passing the evaluation will  not  be subjected to the 1-year validity period for the current and next evaluation. Otherwise, the 1-year commission validity period will remain in effect and will be reset if the threshold is not maintained in subsequent evaluations. 2. Spot Referral and Affiliate Program Effective from  2025-10-01 , we also updated the Spot Referral and Affiliate Program with new evaluation criteria and an automated review process. All eligible users can participate in a 3-month evaluation to earn higher commissions based on the following criteria: Note: * Spot and Margin Trading Volume : Only trades that incur a trading fee will be included in the “Trading Volume” ** New Spot and Margin Traders : The number of users who register during the evaluation period and complete their first Spot and Margin trade within the same evaluation period. Common Rules for Commission Evaluation: Eligible users for evaluation include all Binance users, with the exception of: Sub-accounts; Binance brokers; Binance Wealth users; Users whose current commission rate is 0%;  Users who did not open a Futures account (For Futures Evaluation Only); Users without any referrals opening a Futures account (For Futures Evaluation Only); Users who are residing in a restricted region for the referral, Spot, and Futures products; Users who violate the Binance Referral Terms and Conditions. Users or persons based in restricted countries where the Affiliate Program is not available. Referrals generated through the Co-Inviter Program will be counted toward the Affiliate’s evaluation, including eligible first-time traders and their trading volume. For more information about the Co-Inviter Program, please refer to the  FAQ . Evaluations for existing eligible users start at the  beginning of the calendar   month and last for three consecutive calendar months.  Please note that users who become eligible after the 15th of the month will begin their evaluation from the day of being eligible, and the evaluation will last until the end of the next 3 calendar months.  Example: User A became eligible for evaluation on 17 August,  his/her evaluation period will begin on 17 August until 30 November.  Users can check their evaluation performance period and data by visiting the [ Referral Pro Dashboard ] and clicking on the   [ Futures Evaluation ]  or [ Spot Evaluation ] tab. Upgrading of a commission tier generally takes effect by 08:00 (UTC) the next day after the user meets the criteria. In most cases, the upgrade is completed within a day, and for certain cases, up to 48 hours. Downgrading of a commission tier will be processed within 48 hours after the evaluation period ends. Users who reached a higher tier in the previous evaluation must meet the same tier criteria in the following 3-month evaluation period to retain their affiliate benefits. The evaluation will only assess users’ referral performance from the beginning of the evaluation period onward. Performance prior to the evaluation period will  not  be assessed. Terms and Conditions: The evaluations of Spot and Futures, including their respective results and evaluation periods, are independent of one another. For more information about the evaluation details, please refer to the  FAQ . The Futures Referral Program is exclusively available to users who are eligible to access Binance Futures. Participation may be restricted or prohibited in certain jurisdictions, regions, or for specific users in accordance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements. Users are responsible for informing themselves about and observing any restrictions and/or requirements imposed with respect to the access to and use of Binance Futures trading services in each country/region from which the services are accessed. Binance reserves the right to disqualify trades that are deemed to be wash trades or illegally bulk registered accounts, as well as trades that display attributes of self-dealing or market manipulation. If such activity is detected, all referrals will be canceled and all referral bonuses, including kickbacks for the referral's accounts, will be canceled. Binance reserves the right at any time in its sole and absolute discretion to determine and/or amend or vary these Terms and Conditions without prior notice, including but not limited to canceling, extending, terminating or suspending the evaluation process, its eligibility terms and criteria. All users shall be bound by these amendments. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-07-21 Note :  This announcement was updated on 2026-07-03 with details regarding the Common Rules for Commission Evaluation. This announcement was updated on 2026-06-18 to reflect updates related to bStocks. This announcement was updated on 2026-03-18 to announce the enhancement of Futures regular to VIP 2 referrals in the calculation of Futures trading volume. This announcement was updated on 2025-11-24 to include the mandatory new trader risk check. This announcement was updated on 2025-11-14 to provide clarification on the newly released Futures rebate feature and the definition of new traders.. This announcement was updated on 2025-09-01 to clarify the Tiering system and inform users on how to upgrade to be an affiliate. Common rules on evaluation criteria and the eligibility of Spot and Futures trades to be included into the Trading Volume were also added. Previously, it was updated on 2025-08-07 to emphasize the exception clause meant for Futures Evaluation only.  Then, it was updated on 2025-08-01 to include the exception clause that referral needs to activate the Futures account in order to initiate evaluation. Followed by an update on 2025-07-28 to include wash trades or bulk registered account restrictive terms, and on 2025-07-23 to clarify the gradual removal in 10% futures rebate and the commission upgrade detailed timing.
